description: Dense-vector retrieval over the project-lessons corpus (spaCy GloVe embeddings, cosine similarity) with per-role classification-ceiling governance and citation-bearing results.

ranker.primary: spaCy GloVe word-vector embeddings (en_core_web_md, 300-dim), cosine similarity
ranker.lexical_gate: TF-IDF cosine; rejects anisotropic embedding false positives
ranker.fallback: SQLite FTS5 keyword search when the vector ranker returns nothing

source.description: Origin document; emitted as the citation for a result.

citation_expectation: Every returned result carries source, title, and last_updated so the calling agent cites the lesson it used; governance.py enforces each document's classification against the calling role's ceiling before a result is returned.
